module_summary: SERV register-file to SRAM adapter: a shared cycle counter sequences serial-to-parallel write shift registers and parallel-to-serial read registers for two write and two read ports.

anchors.name: i_wreq
anchors.why: Write request from SERV; restarts rcnt and asserts o_ready.

anchors.name: i_rreq
anchors.why: Read request from SERV; restarts rcnt and opens read gate.

anchors.name: o_ready
anchors.why: Ready to SERV from delayed read grant or write request.

anchors.name: rgnt
anchors.why: Read grant, two-cycle delayed rreq, driving o_ready.

anchors.name: rcnt
anchors.why: Cycle counter sequencing read/write triggers and RAM address LSBs.

anchors.name: wcnt
anchors.why: Write-side count offset from rcnt; times wen capture and write address.

anchors.name: rtrig0
anchors.why: Loads rdata0 from RAM and selects read register port.

anchors.name: rtrig1
anchors.why: Delayed trigger loading rdata1 and selecting o_rdata1 source.

anchors.name: wtrig1
anchors.why: Selects write port 1 data, register and enable toward RAM.

anchors.name: wdata0_r
anchors.why: Shift register collecting serial write port 0 bits into a RAM word.

anchors.name: wdata1_r
anchors.why: Shift register collecting serial write port 1 bits into a RAM word.

anchors.name: wen0_r
anchors.why: Latched write enable for port 0 gating o_wen.

anchors.name: rdata0
anchors.why: Shift register serializing RAM read word to read port 0.

anchors.name: rdata1
anchors.why: Shift register serializing RAM read word to read port 1.

anchors.name: rgate
anchors.why: Read gate set by rreq, drives RAM read enable.

anchors.name: wreg
anchors.why: Selected write register number forming RAM write address.

anchors.name: rreg
anchors.why: Selected read register number forming RAM read address.

anchors.name: i_wdata0
anchors.why: Serial write data port 0 shifted into wdata0_r.

anchors.name: o_rdata0
anchors.why: Serial read data port 0 from rdata0.

anchors.name: o_waddr
anchors.why: RAM write address from selected register and wcnt.

anchors.name: o_wdata
anchors.why: RAM write word muxed from write shift registers.

anchors.name: o_wen
anchors.why: RAM write enable from triggers and latched port enables.

anchors.name: o_raddr
anchors.why: RAM read address from selected register and rcnt.

anchors.name: i_rdata
anchors.why: RAM read word loaded into rdata0/rdata1.

groups.name: Request/sequencing
groups.description: Request handshake, ready generation and shared cycle counter.

groups.name: Write path
groups.description: Deserializes two serial write ports into RAM words, address and enable.

groups.name: Read path
groups.description: Reads RAM words and serializes them to two read ports.
